topics.title: work
topics.essence: Force times the distance moved along it: W = F·d.
topics.check: You carry a box across a level floor at constant speed. How much work does gravity do on it, and why?

topics.title: magnetic force
topics.essence: A moving charge in a magnetic field is pushed sideways: F = qv × B.
topics.check: A charge moves parallel to a magnetic field. What force does it feel? What if it moves across the field instead?

links.why: W = F·d: only the part of the force along the motion does work.
F = qv × B: the push is at right angles to both the velocity and the field.
